grouping.rule: declared group_id merged across near-duplicate prompts; a group never straddles final_test and development (pilot and development_remaining are both development and may share a group)
grouping.note: all 50 bbh-boolean_expressions prompts share an instruction template and form one near-duplicate group; it cannot be split, so that subtask is absent from final_test

prior_exposure.method: test split of the previous pair reconstructed with routing.splits.make_splits defaults (seed 7, 70/15/15); sizes match the documented 420/90/90 but the original splits.json was not available to confirm identity

use.pilot: checking collection and grading only; not a statistical claim
use.development_remaining: with pilot outcomes (same identity), the pool for training, calibration, validation
use.final_test: RESERVED: collect and evaluate once, after the classifier, threshold, grading, split and model pair are frozen and the owner approves the final evaluation; do not inspect outcomes or tune on it

upstream.name: BIG-bench
upstream.note: BBH tasks are derived from BIG-bench tasks; keep the Apache-2.0 attribution and notice when redistributing

contamination: GSM8K (2021), MMLU (2020) and BIG-Bench Hard (2022) are public and widely reproduced; both tiers may have seen them in training. Absolute accuracies may be inflated; the router study compares the two tiers on identical prompts. Not measurable here.
All 600 prompts were used with the previous model pair (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct -> DeepSeek V4 Pro); its reconstructed test split is excluded from final_test.
limitations: final_test has 150 tasks (50 per category); confidence intervals will be wide.
final_test contains no bbh-boolean_expressions tasks (one inseparable near-duplicate group).
No coding, extraction, summarisation, open-ended or long-context tasks (deferred by owner decision).
